nodes.title: Consecutive square-weighted constant of an odd prime to an odd power is at most three

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$, let $p$ be a prime dividing $n$ and let $r = v_p(n)$ be the exponent of $p$ in $n$. For a natural number $m$, write $S(m)$ for the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_m = \mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$ and $C_{S(m)}$ for the $S(m)$-weighted consecutive constant of $\mathbb{Z}_m$. Then $C_{S(n)} \le C_{S(p^r)}$.
nodes.title: Prime-power bound for the square-weighted consecutive constant

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ be an even perfect square. Write $S(n)$ for the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and $D_{S(n)} \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ for the weighted Davenport constant of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ with weight set $S(n)$, a weight acting by multiplication. Then $D_{S(n)} \ge 4$.
nodes.title: Square-weighted Davenport constant of even squares is at least four

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ be a natural number whose exponent $v_2(n)$ of $2$ is even and at least $2$. Write $S(n)$ for the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and $D_{S(n)} \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ for the weighted Davenport constant of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ with weight set $S(n)$, a weight acting by multiplication. Then $D_{S(n)} \ge 3$.
nodes.title: Square-weighted Davenport constant for an even 2-adic valuation of at least two

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ be odd, let $S(n)$ be the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n$, and let $A$ be the set of integers $a$ with $0 \le a < n$ whose residue modulo $n$ lies in $S(n)$. Then the $A$-weighted Davenport constant $D_{S(n)}$ of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ is at least $3$.
nodes.title: The square-weighted Davenport constant of an odd modulus is at least three

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$ and let $S(n)$ be the set of nonzero squares in $\mathbb{Z}_n$. The sequence over $\mathbb{Z}_n$ whose only term is $0$ has an $S(n)$-weighted zero sum: there is a weight $a \in S(n)$ with $a \cdot 0 = 0$.
